title.en: Estate Duty (Tang Yu Kan, Deceased) (Remission) Order 1998

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Estate Duty (Tang Yu Kan, Deceased) (Remission) Order 1998.

2. The estate duty of $26,302.35 payable under the Act on the balance of the Collector of Land Revenue award, ex-gratia payment and cash gift made out of the Collector of Land Revenue award in respect of the property at 38 Starlight Road, Singapore, passing on the death of Tang Yu Kan on 14th December 1996 is hereby remitted.
